headline: NYM @ TOR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYM 3.83 at TOR 4.65, with a projected total of 8.48. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TOR: NYM moved -0.55 runs while TOR moved +0.27, changing the projected margin by -0.81 runs. NRFI probability rose +13.9%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Sean Manaea has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Carson Benge, Bo Bichette, A.J. Ewing, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Brett Baty, Mark Vientos because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
